title: MV Toilet In Wonderland actions, but for MV? (Like an emote or dance)

posts.author: ms_womp
posts.body:
So, as a basic summary for what I mean, in Toilet in Wonderland, in your menu there is an "Actions" tab, and in the tab, you can select actions for the main character to do. Then in the overworld, they'll preform a little taunt with that action you selected when you press the action button (shift)
Here's an example of doing the "\(^o^)/" action
So basically it's just like fortnite emotes lol. I was just wondering, is there any plugins like this, but for RPG Maker MV (TiW is an RPG Maker 2000 game if that'd for some reason be relevant)? Just a plugin that allows you to choose from a group of emotes, and then by pressing a button, you preform that emote? It feels like one of those plugins that you'd expect to exist (especially in recent years with pizza tower and it's taunt system), but looking up stuff like "RPG Maker MV taunt plugin", "RPG Maker MV action plugin", or "RPG Maker MV emote plugin" doesn't really bring up the right results. Mostly just yanfly taunt or cutscene stuff lollll.
If not, it's not the worst thing. I feel it wouldn't be the hardest thing in the world to shoddily make my own version with common events and custom button plugins to preform those events, but having something more streamlined would be nice

posts.author: TheAM-Dol
posts.body:
You could likely use a combination of Yanfly's
Main Menu Manager
and
Button Common events
to execute this.
The main menu common event could just call a common event choice menu that displays your emote choices. When you select the emote choice, set a variable to that value. I would use strings for that variable.
So choice 1 might be:
Variable: "cheer"
choice 2:
variable: "happy"
etc.
Then the button common event is going to be checking for these.
If variable "cheer"
play cheer animation
If variable "happy"
play happy animation
